summary: Iteration 12 — Iteration-16 backend + frontend validation. 46/46 backend pytest pass (14 NEW for notify-cities CRUD + image upload + 32 regression). Currently the request fails silently to the user. Suggested: in the catch block of `add`, set `setErr(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Failed to add city')` and render `{err &&

}` near the button.

(LOW/COSMETIC) Console hydration warning: `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` is emitted on every admin page load. Source is editor-tooling instrumentation (x-ve-dynamic / x-source-var injecting `<span style={{display:'contents'}}>` inside `<option>` of filter-exhibition and notify-filter-city). critical_code_review_comments: [GOOD] Backend Iteration-16 endpoints all clean: NotifyCity model excludes _id (find with {_id:0}), proper Pydantic validation, 409/400/404/401/413 status codes correct. Image upload streams in 64KB chunks and aborts mid-write at 4MB cap (memory-safe). Returns relative /api/uploads/{name} URL — frontend correctly resolves to absolute via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

[GOOD] Startup seed of notify_cities is idempotent (only seeds when collection empty) and derives from existing exhibitions, giving exactly 20 cities (16 domestic + 4 international) matching exhibitions seed.

[GOOD] StaticFiles mount at /api/uploads + UPLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True). Files persisted across requests; uploaded PNG fetched back with content-type image/png and intact magic bytes.
[GOOD] Admin UI: 4-tab navigation works, Notify Cities tab grouping (Domestic/International) is clear, helper text under image upload is descriptive (1200×800, 3:2, JPG/PNG/WebP, 4 MB).

[GOOD] Collection.jsx — autoplay regression FIXED. scrollLeft now advances continuously (~33 px/sec observed) and is NOT paused on hover. Manual arrows move ~320 px and autoplay does not undo the click within 1 s.
[GOOD] Experts.jsx — 'Tap to See' label rendered top-left of card (lab_l ≈ card_l, lab_w=62 < card_w=166), no horizontal overflow on 390×844 mobile.

[BUG-MEDIUM] AdminDashboard NotifyCitiesTab — duplicate add returns 409 but no error UI is shown; user gets no feedback. Same observation likely applies to bad-type / missing-name (400) errors. See action_items.

[NIT] AdminDashboard.jsx is now ~590 lines with 5 components (LeadsTab + NotifyLeadsTab + NotifyCitiesTab + ExhibitionsTab + main). Approaching the 700-line threshold; splitting into separate files in /app/frontend/src/admin/tabs/*.jsx would improve maintainability.

rca_of_the_issue: Duplicate-city UX: api.createNotifyCity throws on 409 but NotifyCitiesTab.add() likely swallows the exception in a try/catch without setting local error state, so the UI shows nothing. Reproduce: admin → Notify Cities → add 'Hyderabad' (already exists as domestic) → click Add → no error message, but Network tab shows 409 with detail "'Hyderabad' already exists for domestic". Mitigation: surface backend detail in form (see action_items).
